info.title: Title Uninstaller
info.author: SudoTronics
info.description: A title uninstaller for the Wii U
info.details: Browse, select, and uninstall game titles from USB storage or the NAND. It's designed as a faster, more capable alternative to the Wii U's built-in Data Management screen, with batch operations.

changelog:
v1.2
New features :

- Added the ability to install titles (accessed moving the right analog stick left/right)
- Added support for uninstalling updates and DLC.
- Injected Virtual Console game are now supported.
- Added an option in settings to keep the screen awake.

Bug fixes :

- Fixed an issue causing game size being misreported.
- Fixed some games appearing twice.
- Minor UI changes.

v1.1
- Added support for Wii Virtual Console titles.
